name: tt-sam3
description: End-to-end port of Meta's SAM3 open-vocabulary segmentation model (840M parameters) to a single Blackhole p150a. The ViT-H/14 backbone and fusion encoder run on the chip as fused, traced device graphs, with the FPN neck, decoder and segmentation head on the host. Ships a torch reference as a numerical shadow, per-stage PCC and end-to-end mask tests, a benchmark and a Tracy-profileable perf test; masks match the fp32 reference at 0.999 IoU.
author: changh95
